images.01: Pre-dawn Tashkent mahalla street at 5:30 am, dark blue sky with first light, many Uzbek men in doppi skullcaps and warm coats walking together toward a lit courtyard with steam rising, street lamps, peaceful and atmospheric.
images.02: Huge cast-iron kazan of plov over a wood fire in a courtyard before dawn, master oshpaz Hamid aka, 60, white apron, embroidered doppi, gray mustache, stirring with a giant kafgir ladle, golden steam and firelight, epic composition.
images.02_b: SMALL CHANGE: same picture, but the oshpaz lifts the giant ladle high showing golden rice and carrots, steam bursting up.
images.03: Young Uzbek groom Javlon, 27, dark suit and white shirt, sleepy but happy, standing at the courtyard gate greeting arriving guests with hand on heart, early morning blue light.
images.04: Long tables in a courtyard with white tablecloths, men in doppi sitting shoulder to shoulder, big round plates of plov with carrots, raisins and meat, non bread and green tea, warm lamp light at dawn.
images.05: Still life close-up: a large lagan plate of Uzbek plov with yellow carrots, chickpeas, quail eggs and slices of meat on top, steam rising, embroidered tablecloth, dramatic warm light, dark background.
images.06: Elderly Uzbek mahalla elder, 75, white beard, chapan robe, raising open hands in blessing (duo) at the head of the table, other men listening respectfully, morning sun rays.
images.07: Sunrise over the courtyard: the oshpaz, the young groom and the elder laughing together next to the empty kazan, guests leaving, warm golden light, feeling of togetherness.

hero: oshpaz usta Hamid aka (60, oq xalat, do'ppi, katta kafgir) + yosh kuyov Javlon (27, kostyum) + mahalla oqsoqoli
